Offer B - £430,000; buyer must sell their own home first; that home is not yet on the market.
Offer C - £405,000; cash buyer; proof of funds seen; wants to complete within 6 weeks and has not said whether that is flexible.

Agency practice: recommend the offer most likely to complete on the seller's date; among offers equally likely, recommend the highest price.
